title: Super Mario
subtitle: the mainline platformers in release order, 2D and 3D
blurb: All 19 mainline platformers, Super Mario Bros. to Wonder — about 145 hours of story.
notes: This is the Super Mario series proper — the games where you run and jump. No RPGs, no karts, no parties, no sports, no Maker, no Run. Remakes and compilations (All-Stars, 3D All-Stars, the Advance ports) aren't separate rows; play any version and tick the original.
The 2D and 3D games sit in their own sections because they are different crafts, each in release order. Almost nothing carries over between games — start anywhere, though 1985 is a fine place.
HowLongToBeat main-story figures — credits, not completion. Odyssey's moons and Wonder's badges can double the number; that is on you.
Game list and years from Wikipedia's Super Mario series article; hours from HowLongToBeat main-story figures, verified by name.
